note: Village of Lake Nebagamon campground in a small wooded ravine in the village, off Camp Nebagamon Drive, a couple of hundred metres from the lake. One camper, one tent and one car per site; extra parking above the campground. --Claude
summary: Village page read: 10 sites (6 electric $30, 4 non-electric tent $15), flush toilets, Memorial Day-Labor Day, FCFS self-registration, 14-day limit, 6 people per site. Season set to 2027 dates (May 31-Sep 6). PIN ~600 m off (stored point is in the woods of the neighbouring Camp Nebagamon youth camp) -> 46.5139,-91.7035. Not waterfront kept.
